references.text: This part of Joshua 15 describes the cities in the hill country that were allotted to the tribe of Judah, and verse 59 is part of this list of cities in the region of Judah.
Beth-Anath is mentioned in connection with the Levitical cities given to the descendants of Aaron from the tribe of Judah.
The pattern of listing cities and their villages follows the same structure used here to describe the settlement pattern in the Promised Land.
A similar listing of cities with their villages is found in the allocation of land to the tribe of Benjamin.
